description: Actively maintained continuation of com.arthenica:ffmpeg-kit-audio (retired, archived April 2025). Same com.arthenica.ffmpegkit API, drop-in replacement -- just change the groupId. Audio codecs: lame, libilbc, libvorbis, opencore-amr, opus, shine, soxr, speex, twolame, vo-amrwbenc. Android SDK 35, 16 KB page size, security-tracked. By Jokobee -- jokobee.com
